napier-8.name: Faraday Museum of Technology
napier-8.bio: A volunteer-run technology museum with hands-on exhibits of applied science.
notes: HELD: museum is closed for urgent maintenance, no reopening date. Days (Mon/Wed/Fri/Sat) are from Napier i-SITE; the museum's own page not parsed. 'Former powerhouse' dropped as unsourced. No English Wikipedia article: wiki omitted. Adult $12 (operator).

napier-9.name: Sugar Loaf (Pukekura)
napier-9.bio: A 127 m hill above Taradale, climbed for 360-degree views across Napier and the Heretaunga Plains.
notes: No ticketUrl: council reserve, no steward page found. Open hours assumed (reserve). Pin is the summit; entry via Cumberland Rise.

napier-10.name: Westshore Beach
napier-10.bio: A beach reserve just north of Napier's centre for swimming, surfing and fishing, patrolled in summer.
notes: No Wikipedia article for the beach (only the suburb): wiki omitted. No ticketUrl (public beach). Pin moved to Westshore Beach Reserve.

napier-11.name: Church Road Winery
napier-11.bio: A winery founded in 1897, with cellar-door tastings and an underground museum in barrel halls and caves.
notes: 'One of the oldest wineries' cut: only 1897 is sourced. Closing time 4:30 PM is an assumption (last tasting 4:00 PM). Standard tastings $25-$45; premium experiences cost more. No Wikipedia article: wiki omitted.

napier-12.name: Waipātiki Beach
napier-12.bio: A broad golden beach with native bush behind, 11 km off SH2 north of Napier, patrolled in summer.
notes: Pin moved from the rounded Wikipedia village point to the beach-front car park. Patrol mid-Dec to late Jan.

napier-13.name: Lake Tūtira
napier-13.bio: A lake and regional park north of Napier, with walking tracks that look to the Kaweka Range.
napier-13.hours: Daylight; Walkway closed for lambing 1 Aug – 30 Sep
notes: Campground fees apply (not read directly); spot recorded free. Area north of the campground reported closed for forestry (unconfirmed). Pin moved to the campsite where the tracks start.

napier-14.name: Ocean Spa
napier-14.bio: Council-run heated pools, spa pools and a steam room on Marine Parade.
notes: HELD: no accepted photo. 'Sea-water' removed: pools are heated and chlorinated. Adult $20 from the operator table (headers read from text). Public sauna closed for maintenance. No Wikipedia article: wiki omitted.

napier-15.name: Ōtātara Pā
napier-15.bio: One of the largest pā complexes in New Zealand, with terraces and storage pits and views to Cape Kidnappers.
notes: HELD: no accepted photo. 'Largest that can be visited' corrected to 'one of the largest'. DOC publishes no hours or fee. Pin moved to the DOC entrance. No Wikipedia article: wiki omitted.

napier-16.name: Mission Estate Winery
napier-16.bio: New Zealand's oldest surviving winemaking concern, founded in 1851 by French missionaries, with tastings.
notes: HELD: no accepted photo. 'Former seminary' dropped (not sourced from the site). Tastings $15 self-guided, $20 hosted. Check whether wiki 'Mission Estate Winery' article exists before adding wiki (not researched).

te-urewera-5.name: Panekire Bluffs
te-urewera-5.bio: A Great Walk climb up the bluffs above Lake Waikaremoana, reaching Bald Knob (1155 m) in three hours.
te-urewera-5.hours: Daylight; Panekire Hut needs a booking
notes: Pin moved from Panekire Hut to the Onepoto trailhead. Visit time 4-8 h is a judgement from DOC's 1 h / 3 h one-way times. Hut $35 adult/night. No Wikipedia article: wiki omitted.

kaweka-forest-park.name: Kaweka Forest Park
kaweka-forest-park.bio: Alpine shrublands and beech forest north-west of Napier, with tramping, hot springs and huts.
notes: Pin at the Lakes Carpark (Kuripapango Road); alternative Mangatutu Hot Springs -39.18267,176.45865. Hut fees separate. Visit time a judgement.

ruahine-forest-park.name: Ruahine Forest Park
ruahine-forest-park.bio: Bush-covered ranges stretching almost 100 km, reached from road ends on the eastern side.
notes: HELD: no distinct visitor point: duplicate pin of Sunrise Track; owner to decide. Coordinates shown are that shared North Block Road end; research gives no other DOC-sourced park access point (Wakarara Road end -39.7407,176.2559 is Yeomans Track's).

sunrise-track.name: Sunrise Track and Sunrise Hut
sunrise-track.bio: A 6.4 km benched track to a 20-bunk hut on the open tops, with views over the Hawke's Bay plains.
notes: Free as a day walk; the hut costs $25-$28 adult per night (not in the cost field). Pin moved from the hut to the track start at North Block Road end. 2-3 h each way is from a search summary of DOC's hut page. No Wikipedia article: wiki omitted.

yeomans-track.name: Yeomans Track
yeomans-track.bio: A 17 km loop on an old log-hauling route to a 1926-1956 mill site and the park's oldest hut.
notes: HELD: reported closed since Cyclone Gabrielle per Hawke's Bay Tourism (DOC page does not say so); also no accepted photo. Pin is the Wakarara Road end; the DOC car park is unmapped. Requires crossing the Makaroro River. No Wikipedia article: wiki omitted.

wairoa-museum.name: Wairoa Museum
wairoa-museum.bio: A museum in a former bank building on Marine Parade, redeveloped in 2016 as Kakapa - the Pulse.
notes: HELD: no accepted photo. needs_owner: free entry is from Wikivoyage 2018 only (council and i-SITE state no fee); marked free:true provisionally. Closed Sun, Mon and public holidays. No Wikipedia article: wiki omitted.

napier-4.bio: A gannet reserve on a headland, reached by a low-tide beach walk or an overland farm tour.
notes: Cost left unchanged: the $99 Gannet Safaris overland adult tour (research) may have closed/changed; owner to confirm. Tractor-trailer wording removed (operator reported closed; headline only read). Plateau track closed July to the week before Labour Weekend; beach walk is tide-dependent.

Not renamed (now Kahukura Hawke's Bay Museum). wiki set to the research-verified article title 'MTG Hawke's Bay' (straight apostrophe); the existing name uses a curly apostrophe so the lookup failed. Exhibitions free; theatre/special events ticketed. Coordinates moved to 1 Tennyson St.
Skipped by instruction: the 13 spots of proposed destinations hastings and central-hawkes-bay.
